description: Risk register for the MC-19 scope proposal and a future authorized implementation. No risk is closed by the proposal.

risks.risk: Scope invented from a one-line placeholder does not match the owner's intent.
risks.mitigation: Stop implementation until P01/P10; bind the exact Master Prompt to the scope revision.

risks.risk: Owners/professional-fleets pages create route or entity collisions, or contradict MC-15.
risks.mitigation: Record an IA/route decision (P02) with a collision check before any code; do not touch LOCALIZED_ROUTES in the internal milestone.

risks.risk: A form, endpoint or lead store is introduced without a lawful privacy basis.
risks.mitigation: Hard gate: no form/input/endpoint/lead store while GATE-PRIVACY-DPA-DPIA is blocked; adversarial tests and independent review.

risks.risk: A segment page is accidentally registered in the public router, sitemap or navigation.
risks.mitigation: Preview-only routes; no production import; build-scan and 404 probes; route-diff check.

risks.risk: Price, stock, purchase, certification or availability claims leak into segment copy or CTAs.
risks.mitigation: Claims guard, copy-class constraints, fail-closed CTA component, adversarial mutations.

risks.risk: The design system is forked or a second bilingual component tree is created.
risks.mitigation: Reuse MC-17 components; import-graph check; empty design-system diff; independent review.

risks.risk: ES/EN parity or translation quality is claimed without evidence.
risks.mitigation: Deterministic parity checks; evidence-provenanced blocks; no claim of professional translation review.

risks.risk: MC-19 solution pages duplicate MC-20-23 family or bundle pages.
risks.mitigation: Decide page ownership in P02; Option A embeds solution context instead of creating bundle routes.

risks.risk: Evidence drifts or counts are prefixed before execution.
risks.mitigation: Single deterministic validator; regenerate datasets; record real command output; independent re-run.

risks.risk: The inherited V-18 financial gate is hidden or reported as green.
risks.mitigation: Keep FINANCIAL_V18 = INHERITED_OPEN; run test:financial and report the real result.

risks.risk: Automated axe results are overstated as WCAG 2.2 AA conformance.
risks.mitigation: State the automated, Chromium-only limits; no conformance claim without manual/screen-reader review.

risks.risk: The loopback preview isolation is weakened (public bind, Host allowlist removed, noindex lost).
risks.mitigation: Keep the MC-18 server controls; isolation probes and adversarial mutations; independent review.

risks.risk: A late Master Prompt rebinds the scope after implementation starts.
risks.mitigation: Do not start before P01 is frozen; bind the prompt to a scope revision; re-plan if it changes.

risks.risk: The stacked draft PR is merged or deployed by mistake.
risks.mitigation: Draft PR only; no merge/deploy; explicit base/head; delivery record states the state.
